shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses

sides.
Switch off control current for CB (DC)
Tester (digital Avometer).
Set off spanners and screw drivers.
Oscillograph .
Silicon grease .
500/1000 V Megger .
Contact resistance meter .
Vacuum cleaner.
Check the value of the Capacitor.
Check 220 kv CB control panel (retightening & cleaning).
Grease mechanical parts.
Check operating mechanism.
Open the earthing switch on both sides of the breaker
Switch on control current for CB (DC)
Close the work permit.

Introduction
This document outlines the minor maintenance procedure P1, which must be 
 performed every three years or every 1000 operation as indicated by Y3 
 in the above title block..
The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Mohamed Shalash, reviewed

 eng. Adel El Naggar, approved by eng Ahmed Sawan head sector of Nubaria Power
